hooks.command: if command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1; then bun run "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/cli.ts" register; else echo 'spochie: Bun is not installed, so spochie cannot register this session. Tell the user to run: curl -fsSL https://bun.sh/install | bash  and restart Claude Code.'; fi
command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 && bun run "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/src/cli.ts" unregister || true
